name: Realize
source: One morning during the class, Matsuura Ryou saw a strange object flying in the sky. Orange body was falling in a strange dancing pattern, vaguely resembling movements of the life form. This was his first encounter with EGO which led to contact with mysterious girl - Shibaura Yae that completely changed Ryou's life and destiny.
translation: 一天早晨的课堂上，松浦亮看见天空中飞过一个奇怪物体。橙色的躯体以诡异的舞蹈轨迹向下坠落，动作隐约像是某种生命体。这是他第一次遇见EGO，也由此接触到神秘少女芝浦八重。亮的人生与命运从此彻底改变。
